detail.scope_rule: AMENDMENT 4 §3-2 verbatim: every anchor where BOTH arms wrote a book at the PREVIOUS anchor
detail.precision: 4 dp, the archive's own recorded precision

detail.threshold_rationale: write_target_live L70-73 keeps a name only when |v| > 1e-9, so a perturbation below that cannot change any weight that reaches a target file; the threshold is derived, not picked
detail.note_vs_amendment: the amendment states 2,190 anchors and ~1e-100; recomputed here from the config and the axis as 2191 anchors and 5.563e-101 — same order, the anchor count differs by one

adversarial_check_on_clause_2.question: clause 2 conditions on 'both arms wrote at the previous anchor', so it is blind on the anchors that FOLLOW a non-write. Does that blind set contain the actual divergence?
adversarial_check_on_clause_2.finding: the divergence is NOT in clause 2's blind set, so clause 2 is JUDGING this arm at that anchor rather than exempting it
adversarial_check_on_clause_2.residual_hole: an intervention that altered w3 ONLY at anchors following a non-write would pass all three clauses. For this arm that hole is 1 anchor(s) wide and does not contain the divergence, so it does not affect this verdict; it is stated because the amendment asked for the detection-power argument to be attacked.
